sentences.text: This synthetic document describes the Ag–Sn binary system as calculated with pycalphad from the SGTE dataset AgSn-12Gie.tdb; every figure, table and stated value is generated, and the exact values are kept in a separate truth key.
The highest invariant reaction, (Ag) + L → ζ, lies at 719 °C.
The Ag–Sn system belongs to the 20 binaries of the ORCHID benchmark, chosen to cover diagram types such as peritectic.
The thermodynamic description is the SGTE collection entry (Hallstedt, 2025), which reproduces the assessment of W. Gierlotka, J. Electron. Mater., 41, 86-108(2012).
The calculations use pycalphad 0.11.2 at 1 atm.
The melting point of Sn reproduced by the dataset is 232 °C.
The dataset places a peritectic ((Ag) + L → ζ) at 719 °C; the composition of L is a mole fraction of 0.211.
At 488 °C the peritectic ζ + L → Ag3Sn takes place; the L phase then contains x(Sn) = 0.473.
The dataset places a eutectic (L → Ag3Sn + (Sn)) at 220 °C; the composition of L is a mole fraction of 0.961.
At 1300 K the integral mixing enthalpy of the liquid has its minimum, −3147 J/mol, at x(Sn) = 0.220.
The calculated enthalpy of formation of ζ at 298.15 K is −2.67 kJ/mol per mole of atoms.
This document is synthetic and exists only to test extraction tools; its truth key lists every boundary, field, invariant, plotted point, table cell and stated value.
